MECA.TITLE: Display Precautions Related to Vehicle Load and Road Surface Conditions

ITEM.PTXT: Note that, depending on the number of occupants, load conditions, road gradient and unevenness, errors may occur between the distances and course shown by the distance guide lines and estimated course and the actual distances and course on the road surface.
